key_facts: Driver Gabriel Bortoleto, car 5, Audi Revolut F1 Team moved under braking into Turn 5 during the race.
The car made contact with car 43, forcing it to leave the track.
This breached Article 2 e) of Chapter IV of the FIA International Sporting Code, which prohibits moving under braking in a way that causes dangerous driving or contact.
The Stewards issued a Warning, which is equivalent to a black/white flag (a warning for unsportsmanlike driving).
plain_explanation: Gabriel Bortoleto received a Warning for moving his car under braking into Turn 5. His car hit another car (car 43) and forced it off the track. A Warning is the standard penalty for this kind of infringement. A black/white flag is a warning that signals the driver must stop their unsportsmanlike behaviour, or they face a penalty.
